title: Product Manager
description:
**Job Description:**

The Product Manager will be responsible for defining product strategy, managing the product roadmap, gathering business requirements, prioritizing product features, and driving successful product delivery from concept through production. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with engineering, design, QA, business stakeholders, and customers to deliver scalable, high-quality healthcare software solutions.

This role requires a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, excellent stakeholder management skills, and extensive experience building software products for the US healthcare industry.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Strategy & Vision

* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* Identify market opportunities through customer research, competitive analysis, and industry trends.
* Translate business goals into product initiatives and measurable outcomes.
* Drive innovation by identifying opportunities to improve healthcare workflows and operational efficiency.

2. Product Roadmap & Planning

* Develop and maintain the product roadmap.
* Define release plans, milestones, and feature priorities.
* Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business value, and delivery timelines.
* Collaborate with leadership to align product investments with organizational goals.

3. Product Backlog Management

* Own and manage the product backlog.
* Create, prioritize, and refine backlog items based on business value and customer impact.
* Ensure backlog items are detailed, actionable, and ready for development.
* Manage feature dependencies and coordinate with multiple teams.

4. Requirement Gathering & Documentation

* Work closely with business stakeholders, customers, operations teams, and engineering teams to gather requirements.
* Prepare and maintain:
* Business Requirement Documents (BRD)
* Functional Requirement Documents (FRD)
* User Stories
* Acceptance Criteria
* Functional Specifications
* Product Requirement Documents (PRD)
* Create user flows, workflow diagrams, business process maps, and functional documentation.
* Ensure requirements are complete, traceable, and aligned with business objectives.

5. Agile Product Management

* Serve as the Product Manager within Agile Scrum teams.
* Lead backlog refinement sessions.
* Participate in Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Define sprint goals and collaborate with engineering teams to achieve sprint commitments.
* Support estimation, planning, and release management activities.

6. Cross-functional Leadership

Collaborate closely with:

* Software Development Teams
* QA Engineers
* Business Analysts
* UI/UX Designers
* DevOps Engineers
* Customer Success Teams
* Operations Teams
* Executive Leadership
* External Customers and Business Stakeholders

* Define acceptance criteria for all product features.
* Review completed features against business requirements.
* Participate in sprint demonstrations and release reviews.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Validate production readiness prior to release.
* Support production deployments and post-release monitoring.

8. Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and engineering teams.
* Present product roadmaps, release plans, and product progress to leadership.
* Facilitate discussions to resolve functional and business challenges.
* Ensure stakeholder expectations are managed effectively.

9. Product Performance & Continuous Improvement

* Define product success metrics and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Analyze customer feedback and product usage data.
* Identify opportunities for product enhancements and process improvements.
* Drive continuous product innovation and optimization.

**Reporting To:** Management / Business Head

1. Job Purpose

HEC Hospitality is looking for a dynamic, commercially driven and result-oriented Product Manager to take ownership of the SBT (Software-Based Tool) product, from its successful launch to market expansion and business growth.

The candidate will be responsible for coordinating with software vendors and technical partners to ensure the product is successfully developed, tested and made live. Following the product launch, the primary responsibility will be to introduce the SBT Tool to the market, acquire clients, conduct product demonstrations, onboard customers and ensure effective product utilisation.

The role will carry direct sales and revenue responsibilities, with performance-linked incentives. As the business expands, the candidate will also be responsible for developing and leading a dedicated sales and customer support team.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

**A. Product Launch & Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with software vendors, technology partners and internal stakeholders for the successful launch of the SBT Tool.
* Ensure timely completion of software development, API integration, testing and implementation activities.
* Track project milestones, deliverables and pending technical requirements.
* Conduct product testing and coordinate necessary modifications before the final go-live.
* Act as the primary coordination point between management, software vendors and internal teams.
* Ensure all technical and operational dependencies are addressed before launching the product in the market.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure timely resolution of technical issues and product enhancements.

**B. Product Strategy & Market Development**

* Take complete ownership of introducing and positioning the SBT Tool in the target market.
* Develop strategies for product promotion, market penetration and business expansion.
* Identify potential industries, businesses and clients that can benefit from the SBT Tool.
* Conduct direct client meetings, presentations and product demonstrations.
* Understand market requirements, competitor offerings and customer expectations.
* Identify opportunities to improve product features and commercial positioning.
* Build a strong client pipeline and establish the product's market presence.

**C. Sales & Business Development**

* Drive end-to-end sales activities for the SBT Tool.
* Generate leads through direct meetings, networking, references, cold calling and other business development channels.
* Present product features, benefits and business value propositions to prospective clients.
* Prepare commercial proposals, quotations and negotiate deals within approved company pricing.
* Convert prospective clients into active customers.
* Achieve assigned monthly, quarterly and annual sales and revenue targets.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective clients and ensure timely deal closures.
* Explore cross-selling, upselling and additional business opportunities.

**D. Client Onboarding & Implementation**

* Manage the complete client onboarding process, from commercial closure to successful product activation.
* Understand client requirements and coordinate with technical teams for appropriate implementation.
* Ensure clients receive proper product demonstrations, training and usage guidance.
* Coordinate with vendors and support teams to ensure smooth implementation.
* Monitor onboarding timelines and ensure clients start using the software effectively.
* Maintain strong relationships with newly onboarded and existing clients.

**E. Client Performance & Product Utilisation**

* Regularly track the performance and utilisation of the SBT Tool across onboarded clients.
* Monitor active users, product adoption, usage patterns and customer engagement.
* Conduct periodic client reviews to understand satisfaction and identify improvement areas.
* Collect feedback and communicate enhancement requirements to vendors and technical teams.
* Ensure client issues are resolved within agreed timelines.
* Monitor customer retention, renewals and opportunities for account growth.
* Prepare monthly reports on client performance, product adoption and revenue contribution.

**F. Revenue & Business Performance Management**

* Take direct ownership of the product's commercial performance and revenue growth.
* Establish sales targets and business development milestones in consultation with management.
* Monitor lead generation, conversion ratios, client acquisition and revenue performance.
* Track sales pipeline, deal closures and pending payments.
* Analyse business performance and identify opportunities to improve profitability.
* Present periodic business review reports to management with achievements, challenges and action plans.

**G. Team Building & Leadership**

* Initially manage product sales, client onboarding and business development activities.
* Gradually recruit, develop and lead a dedicated team of sales executives and customer support personnel.
* Allocate targets and responsibilities to team members.
* Monitor individual and team performance through structured MIS and reporting.
* Train the team on product knowledge, sales techniques, client handling and onboarding procedures.
* Establish standard operating procedures for sales, onboarding and customer support.
* Ensure coordination between sales, operations, technical vendors and customer support teams.
* Drive overall team productivity and achievement of business targets.

* Ability to coordinate with technical vendors and translate business requirements into actionable deliverables.

description:
#### **Role Overview**

We are looking for a sharp, data-driven, and user-obsessed **Associate Product Manager** to join our product team. As a fresher or recent graduate with strong SQL and analytical capabilities, you will work directly with Senior Product Managers, Engineering, Design, Credit/Risk, and Operations teams to build and optimize seamless digital financial journeys, from customer onboarding and KYC to loan disbursals and repayments.

#### **Key Result Areas (KRAs) & Responsibilities**

* **Data Extraction & Funnel Analytics (SQL-Driven):** Write complex SQL queries to pull product telemetry, analyze customer drop-offs across onboarding, e-KYC, credit underwriting, and payment funnels, and identify high-impact friction points.
* **Requirement Gathering & Documentation:** Assist in writing clear Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria backed by data insights for mobile app and web features.
* **Experimentation & Metric Tracking:** Define success metrics, build self-serve dashboards, and track post-launch feature adoption, conversion rates, and retention cohorts.
* **Cross-Functional Execution:** Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers, tech leads, and QA teams during sprint planning, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and product releases.
* **Compliance & Risk Alignment:** Work alongside Risk, Fraud Control (FCU), and Compliance teams to ensure product flows adhere to RBI digital lending guidelines and data security standards.

#### **Eligibility & Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (B.Tech/B.E., BBA, B.Com, Economics, Statistics, MBA, or related quantitative fields) , **2025 or 2026 graduates only**.
* **Prior Exposure (Preferred):** Internships, live projects, data/product case study competitions, or academic projects involving SQL querying, product analytics, or fintech workflows.

#### **Skills & Competencies**

* **Strong SQL Proficiency (Must-Have):** Hands-on ability to write clean, efficient SQL queries (joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, and aggregations) to independently analyze large transactional and user-event datasets.
* **Analytical & Quantitative Mindset:** Comfort with Excel/Google Sheets and interpreting product/fintech metrics (funnel conversion, TAT, cohort retention, approval rates).
* **Product Sense:** Strong user empathy, wireframing basics (Figma/Balsamiq), and the ability to break complex financial workflows into simple user steps.
* **Communication & Agility:** Ability to translate raw data and business requirements into structured documentation for engineering teams while thriving in a fast-paced environment.

title: Staff, AI Product Manager
description:
**Job Purpose:**

As the Staff,AI Product Manager, you will be the day-to-day strategic partner for forward deployed engineering (FDE) pods working on a set of high-impact engagements. This is an individual contributor role for someone who can take a complex business problem, structure it, size the value, prototype hands-on, and turn it into something a forward deployed engineer can build against.

You won’t manage engineers — you will be in the room with them, the business sponsor, and the data, translating between all three and keeping each engagement focused on the most valuable outcome.

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. In this role, you will make sure the engineers we deploy are working on the right things by:

* Sizing value, structuring problems, building concept prototypes, and writing the business cases that fund engagements.
* Acting as the day-to-day strategic counterpart to FDE pods in active deployments.
* Bringing opportunity signals from business sponsors back into the portfolio.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Opportunity identification and value sizing**

* Surface and size AI opportunities across your assigned engagements and adjacent business units, producing one-page opportunity briefs that are easy to compare and prioritise.
* Build credible value cases with finance-grade reasoning behind cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, or cost avoided.
* Develop hands-on domain knowledge of your engagement areas — workflows, data, decisions, and the people who own them.

**Strategic prioritisation and portfolio shaping**

* Recommend what to start, continue, and stop across your engagements based on evidence, not enthusiasm.
* Sequence work for impact, helping engineering leads decide what is in scope this sprint, what comes next, and what is out.

**Engineering partnership and enablement**

* Be the day-to-day strategic partner to FDE pods, converting business ambiguity into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can act on.
* Run engagement structure end-to-end — scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways — drafted, agreed, and revisited.
* Spot reusable patterns that should become platform capabilities instead of point solutions.

**Stakeholder alignment and communication**

* Work confidently with Director-level business and scientific stakeholders, running working sessions that move things forward and produce decisions, not just notes.
* Maintain sponsor confidence with concise updates, honest risk calls, and clear asks.

**Measurement, learning, and iteration**

* Track value realisation on each engagement against the business case written up front.
* Capture lessons rigorously and feed them back into how the team scopes the next engagement.

**Required Skills:**

* 18+ years of professional experience with bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with the combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML products, product management, or strategy roles in technology-led organisations are preferred.
* A track record of taking complex, ambiguous business problems and turning them into structured, sized opportunities with defensible business cases.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one area of the pharma value chain (such as R&D, supply chain, or commercial), including how decisions actually get made on the ground.
* Technical fluency in modern AI/ML — enough to design realistic engagements with engineers and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Strong individual contributor instincts — you produce quality artefacts, not status updates.

**Preferred Skills**:

* Experience in Global Supply Chain (GSC), particularly Quality and Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT).
* Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, the ML lifecycle, and evaluation patterns, with the ability to assess data readiness (availability, quality, access constraints, and labelling) before engineering starts.
* Understanding of how GxP, regulatory, and data-governance requirements shape AI deployments in pharma — and how to factor them into scoping without over-constraining engineering.
* Experience producing value cases with clear assumptions and sensitivity ranges, and maintaining an opportunity portfolio with clear rationale for what is in flight, queued, or de-prioritised.
* Product intuition: a clear understanding of the difference between an MVP, a product, and a platform, and the ability to spot patterns that should become shared capabilities.
* An AI-native way of working — codifying product management and user research best practices into reusable skills, plugins, and markdown files, and using the command line to automate everyday tasks.
* Ability to lead through influence and write crisp, outcome-focused communications that connect progress to the value case.
* Experience running honest retrospectives that distinguish execution failures from selection failures.

description:
**Company Description**

**Purpose of the role**

Bosch Mobility Platform and Solutions (MPS) builds software platforms and digital services for the mobility ecosystem: tolling and traffic, logistics and fleets, commerce and marketplaces, financial services, and the cloud and data platform that runs underneath them. MPS works with partners and customers across India, Europe and North America, and operates like a digital-native business inside Bosch.

Toll.OS is the open-road tolling and traffic platform of Bosch MPS for Indian highways. It combines RFID and FASTag reads, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and sensors into one verified transaction, and it runs on a layered architecture from the roadside edge to back-office reconciliation. It is live on a national highway today and is designed to scale from one gantry to many corridors.

The Toll.OS play also covers intelligent traffic management and enforcement at junctions and corridors, and the integration of tolling with highway Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) as national highway authorities specify in their tenders. The Product Manager owns this play as a product: what is built, how it performs in the field, what it costs to run, and what it needs to win the next deployment.

 **Job Description**

**What the role owns**

**Product strategy and roadmap** - Own and evolve the roadmap across tolling (multi-lane free flow and plaza software), intelligent traffic management and enforcement, and integration with highway ATMS. Sequence work by customer need, economics, certification effort and regulatory readiness.

**Field learning into requirements** - Work from live deployments: recognition accuracy, manual validation rate, reconciliation gaps, notice and dispute failures, incident root causes. Turn each pattern into a prioritised backlog item with an owner.

**Recognition and sensor-fusion quality** - Define accuracy and confidence targets across RFID, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and other sensors. Work with engineering and AI teams on model, camera and edge decisions, and lead make-or-buy choices on components.

**Interoperability, compliance and security** - Ensure the product meets national interoperability specifications for electronic toll collection, RFID and equipment standards, certification requirements, data protection, audit logging and retention. Work with Legal and Compliance on regulatory change.

**Tender and bid support** - Own the technical content of responses to highway authority and concessionaire tenders: compliance matrices, equivalence of components, architecture and service-level proposals. Work with Finance on bid-versus-investment discipline.

**Deployment and operations readiness** - Define site readiness, integration with acquirer banks and payment networks, settlement and reconciliation, service-level design and acceptance criteria. Hand over cleanly to operations and keep the live KPIs visible.

**Unit economics** - Own cost per passage and cost per plaza, and shape transaction-fee and service models with Finance, so the product stays competitive in price-led tenders.

**Ecosystem and partners** - Work with highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and hardware vendors. Work with the Global Partner Manager on technology and supplier partnerships.

**Platform and data integration** - Publish passage and vehicle events into the Mobility Prism platform so the same vehicle can be understood across tolling, traffic and other services, within consent and data protection rules.

**Team and ways of working** - Guide the product owners and engineering squads working on Toll.OS using agile (SAFe) practices, and build the product-management discipline of the team through coaching and clear decision records

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Recognition accuracy and share of passages verified without manual review
* Time from field issue to product fix
* Cost per passage and cost per plaza trend
* Technical compliance rate and win rate on tenders the role supported
* Deployment lead time from contract to go-live
* Reconciliation and settlement accuracy with acquirer banks
* Number of corridors and plazas running on the standard product
* Quality of field feedback captured into the roadmap

 **Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (electronics, electrical, computer science, civil or transportation); a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, systems engineering or programme leadership in intelligent transport systems, electronic toll collection, smart-city or transport technology, payments infrastructure or computer-vision based systems.
* Has owned a product or system through design, certification, field deployment and operation, and has seen how it behaves when real traffic arrives.
* Experience in public-sector or regulated procurement (tenders, compliance matrices, service-level and performance guarantees) is strongly preferred.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Electronic toll collection: FASTag and national electronic toll collection specifications, RFID standards, acquirer and issuer roles, settlement and reconciliation.
* Number-plate recognition, computer vision and sensor fusion; understanding of accuracy metrics, confidence cascades and model monitoring.
* Edge computing, plaza and back-office systems, and integration through APIs; familiarity with traffic management and enforcement systems is an advantage.
* Certification, equipment standards, cybersecurity and data protection as they apply to roadside systems.
* Able to read an architecture, challenge a design and translate field problems into engineering requirements.

**Commercial skills**

* Unit economics, pricing and service-level commercials; comfortable with a P&L view of a product.
* Negotiation and relationship skills with authorities, banks and vendors.

**Personal attributes**

* Strong ownership and bias to action; comfortable operating with ambiguity in a new business.
* Field-minded: willing to spend time at sites and with operations teams, with regular domestic travel.
* Clear structured communicator, in writing and in the room, who can explain a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
* Integrity and discretion when working with public authorities and sensitive data.
* Collaborative leader who influences without formal authority across engineering, business and partners.

 **Additional Information**

**Who the role works with**

* Product Area Leader for the UtilizationStack (MPS/PAZ)
* Engineering, AI and DevSecOps teams
* Delivery, site and operations teams
* Bid and tender team, and the Global Partner Manager
* Finance, Legal and Compliance
* Regional business leadership (MPS/RBR)
* Highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and vendors
* Product owners for Mobility Prism and for financial services built on toll data

**How to read this role**

This is a product-ownership role with business accountability, not a project management or pure engineering role. The ideal candidate combines systems depth, field experience, commercial judgement and the ability to win trust with authorities and partners.

description:
**Job Purpose:**

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you will be the day-to-day strategic partner for forward deployed engineering (FDE) pods working on a set of high-impact engagements. This is an individual contributor role for someone who can take a complex business problem, structure it, size the value, prototype hands-on, and turn it into something a forward deployed engineer can build against.

You won’t manage engineers — you will be in the room with them, the business sponsor, and the data, translating between all three and keeping each engagement focused on the most valuable outcome.

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. In this role, you will make sure the engineers we deploy are working on the right things by:

* Sizing value, structuring problems, building concept prototypes, and writing the business cases that fund engagements.
* Acting as the day-to-day strategic counterpart to FDE pods in active deployments.
* Bringing opportunity signals from business sponsors back into the portfolio.

**Responsibilities:**

  

**Opportunity identification and value sizing**

* Surface and size AI opportunities across your assigned engagements and adjacent business units, producing one-page opportunity briefs that are easy to compare and prioritise.
* Build credible value cases with finance-grade reasoning behind cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, or cost avoided.
* Develop hands-on domain knowledge of your engagement areas — workflows, data, decisions, and the people who own them.

**Strategic prioritisation and portfolio shaping**

* Recommend what to start, continue, and stop across your engagements based on evidence, not enthusiasm.
* Sequence work for impact, helping engineering leads decide what is in scope this sprint, what comes next, and what is out.

**Engineering partnership and enablement**

* Be the day-to-day strategic partner to FDE pods, converting business ambiguity into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can act on.
* Run engagement structure end-to-end — scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways — drafted, agreed, and revisited.
* Spot reusable patterns that should become platform capabilities instead of point solutions.

**Stakeholder alignment and communication**

* Work confidently with Director-level business and scientific stakeholders, running working sessions that move things forward and produce decisions, not just notes.
* Maintain sponsor confidence with concise updates, honest risk calls, and clear asks.

**Measurement, learning, and iteration**

* Track value realisation on each engagement against the business case written up front.
* Capture lessons rigorously and feed them back into how the team scopes the next engagement.

**Required Skills:**

* 15+ years of professional experience with bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with the combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML products, product management, or strategy roles in technology-led organisations are preferred.
* A track record of taking complex, ambiguous business problems and turning them into structured, sized opportunities with defensible business cases.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one area of the pharma value chain (such as R&D, supply chain, or commercial), including how decisions actually get made on the ground.
* Technical fluency in modern AI/ML — enough to design realistic engagements with engineers and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Strong individual contributor instincts — you produce quality artefacts, not status updates.

**Preferred Skills**:

  

* Experience in Global Supply Chain (GSC), particularly Quality and Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT).
* Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, the ML lifecycle, and evaluation patterns, with the ability to assess data readiness (availability, quality, access constraints, and labelling) before engineering starts.
* Understanding of how GxP, regulatory, and data-governance requirements shape AI deployments in pharma — and how to factor them into scoping without over-constraining engineering.
* Experience producing value cases with clear assumptions and sensitivity ranges, and maintaining an opportunity portfolio with clear rationale for what is in flight, queued, or de-prioritised.
* Product intuition: a clear understanding of the difference between an MVP, a product, and a platform, and the ability to spot patterns that should become shared capabilities.
* An AI-native way of working — codifying product management and user research best practices into reusable skills, plugins, and markdown files, and using the command line to automate everyday tasks.
* Ability to lead through influence and write crisp, outcome-focused communications that connect progress to the value case.
* Experience running honest retrospectives that distinguish execution failures from selection failures.

Agentic Platforms, Global Supply Chain, Global Supply Chain Strategy, Pharmaceutical Supply Chain, User Needs Analysis

title: Sr Product Manager - Payments Platform
description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.

Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.

It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.

Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.

In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.

**About the role**

When a contractor in Brazil gets paid on time, a business in Singapore settles in the right currency, or a payroll platform moves money to 40 countries without a single failure: that's what a good payments platform looks like from the outside. From the inside, it's hard decisions about which rails to build on, what reliability means at scale, and how to make a platform handling billions a month behave consistently across markets with completely different rules.

Nium processes cross-border payments for banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms across 100+ countries. The Senior PM - Payments Platform owns the rails those payments run on.

### **Responsibilities**

* **Reliability.** Define what "good" looks like for corridor performance, settlement success, and straight-through processing. Set the targets, own them, move them.

* **Corridor and market design**. Each market has its own mechanics and failure modes. You translate that into requirements: what the corridor supports, how failure is handled, what go-live looks like, so the products built on top can make promises to customers and keep them.

* **Integration standards.**You set the bar for what gets built with correspondent banks, local networks, and processors globally. You decide which integrations are worth doing, weighing partner economics and business impact against build and maintenance cost, and you push the ones that matter through to delivery.

* **Resilience.** Design for failure: redundancy, failover, degraded modes. The goal is a platform where a single rail going down doesn't mean customers feel it.

* **AI and agentic payment flows**. This is the frontier. Payments infrastructure today is reactive: something breaks, someone fixes it. We want infrastructure that thinks: routes intelligently, detects degradation before customers feel it, reconciles autonomously, resolves failures without human escalation. Nium wants to be the first payments infrastructure company to make agentic flows core to how money moves. You define what that looks like and build it.

### **Requirements**

* Payments experience at real scale: high volume, multi-market, genuine accountability when things break. You understand the mechanics (settlement windows, return codes, reconciliation, failure handling) well enough to bring unambiguous requirements.

* Curious about how payments work across markets. AI-native in how you work. Rigorous about prioritization. Opinionated, not passive: you form a point of view on how a corridor or integration should work, and you push it forward rather than waiting to be told what to build.

* You push Engineering on trade-offs and bring them along with you, holding ground on what's right for the corridor and the business without needing positional authority to do it. And above all, you are passionate about the customer outcome at the end of the transaction, not the platform for its own sake.

* 3-5 years in product management. Payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure is a requirement. Experience with real-time rails (UPI, SEPA, RTP, Pix, or equivalents) is a strong plus.

**The Opportunity**

Most payments PMs work on one market, one rail, one product type. Here you work on all of them simultaneously: Asia-Pacific, Americas, Europe, MENA, all with different mechanics and failure modes. The exposure you get in two years compresses what usually takes a decade.

The team is small, senior, and ambitious. The infrastructure you build will process tens of billions of dollars a month and affect the finances of real people and businesses, including the first generation of payments that run through AI agents rather than human-initiated flows.

**How We’ll Measure You**

* Corridor success rate and STP rate, moved quarter over quarter.

* Settlement failure rate and time-to-resolution.

* Integration delivery against committed dates.

description:
**Senior Product Manager**

**Response Automation (SIEM and SOAR)**

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the automation foundations that help security teams and AI agents turn detections into fast, safe, consistent response.

Finding a threat is half the job. Analysts still spend too much time enriching alerts, chasing context, opening tickets, and running containment steps by hand. As AI agents take on more of that work, response automation has to be dependable, auditable, and easy to control. This role owns the playbook, orchestration, and case management capabilities across Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR that make that possible.

You will own established automation capabilities while building toward agent-driven response and a tighter SIEM-to-SOAR experience. This is a technically deep role. It requires first-hand experience with security operations, SOAR, or workflow automation products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into capabilities that SOC teams adopt and trust.

**What You Will Own**

**Playbooks and the automation engine.** The playbook editor, triggers, actions, execution engine, and the Automation Service. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing power, ease of use, and cost for analysts, detection engineers, and agents.

**Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR together.** Define how insights and signals in Cloud SIEM trigger automations and hand off to Cloud SOAR for incident and case management. Establish where the Automation Service ends and full Cloud SOAR begins, with clear packaging, upgrade paths, and one coherent customer experience.

**Integrations, actions, and App Central.** Set the strategy for enrichment, notification, containment, user choice, and custom actions. Prioritize integrations across endpoint, identity, cloud, ticketing, threat intelligence, and messaging tools. Own coverage, quality, and lifecycle for out-of-the-box playbooks and integrations.

**Agentic and human-in-the-loop response.** Define how AI agents discover, invoke, and chain playbooks and actions. Establish the approval steps, scoped permissions, guardrails, and audit trails that let customers decide which responses run automatically and which need an analyst's sign-off.

  

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for response automation, connecting current SOC needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation and response.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping playbook, automation, and case management capabilities, using customer feedback and execution data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on execution reliability, scalability, error handling, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate response use cases, such as phishing, compromised identity, and endpoint containment, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the integration and action strategy, including how actions are named, scoped, versioned, and made safe to run without a person watching.
* Partner with detection, investigation, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared automation capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure automation respects established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure playbook success rate, time to respond, analyst time saved, reliability, cost, and adoption, and show how automation improvements lead to better security outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of security operations, SOAR, SIEM, or workflow automation products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of incident response workflows, orchestration engines, event-driven systems, APIs, and the integrations that connect security tools.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams, partners, or external developers.
* The ability to reason about automation risk, including false positives, partial failures, and the point where a human should approve an action.
* Familiarity with SOC operations and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the NIST incident response lifecycle. Experience with case management, threat intelligence, or integration marketplaces is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover tools, take actions, and operate within guardrails, or the ability to ramp quickly. Hands-on SOC or security engineering experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in response time, analyst workload, or risk reduction.
* **Safety and trust.** Treats control, auditability, and predictable behavior as product requirements, especially when automation takes action on its own.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS), which includes Multichannel Commerce Fulfillment (MCCF), lets merchants use Amazon’s fulfilment and logistics network to reach customers wherever they shop: their own websites, social commerce, other marketplaces and wholesale. description:
**Who We Are?**

Cleantech Industry Resources accelerates solar, wind, green hydrogen, battery storage, and EV infrastructure projects across the United States, India, and EMEA markets. The company provides turnkey "Development as a Service," powered by 100% internal systems engineering and a world-class team that comes out of some of the most reputed organizations in the renewables industry. This team operates within a sophisticated software and AI environment to support projects from land origination, through to commercial operation.

* Opportunity to join a top-notch, collaborative team of professionals
* Fantastic team environment and collaborative culture
* Professional development opportunities to grow into an industry leader
* Medical Insurance for the employee and family
* Spot Recognition bonus for exceptional performance
* Long Term Incentive policy
* Regular team outings, events, and activities to foster a positive work environment

**Our Commitment to Diversity**

At CIR, we are dedicated to nurturing a diverse and equitable workforce that truly reflects our community. We deeply value each person’s unique perspective, skills, and experiences. CIR embraces all individuals, regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or nationality. We are steadfast in our commitment to fostering a just and inclusive world through intentional policies and actions. Your individuality enriches our collective strength, and we strive to ensure everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered.

**Position Summary**

We are looking for an AI Product Manager to lead cross-functional teams in defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmaps for our AI-powered digital products at scale. The role sits at the intersection of product strategy, applied AI, and renewable energy domain expertise, and will drive the next generation of our internal and market-facing products.

Building on the success of our existing platforms, the AI Product Manager will play a central role in advancing our shift toward agentic, AI-native solutions, translating business objectives and user needs into products that enable smarter automation, faster decision-making, and measurable productivity gains across the organization.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Strategy & Vision:** Define product goals, multi-quarter roadmaps, and go-to-market plans for AI-powered internal tools and customer-facing products, aligned with business objectives and user needs.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Partner with engineering, data science, legal, sales, and domain experts to guide products from ideation to launch through influence rather than direct authority.
* **Data-Driven Iteration:** Analyze user behavior and market trends, design experiments, and iterate rapidly based on post-launch metrics.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:** Communicate technical and strategic trade-offs to executive leadership and build consensus across departments.
* **Product Discovery & Prioritization:** Identify high-impact AI use cases across engineering, design, project development, and business teams, and translate them into clear product requirements, user stories, and a prioritized backlog.
* **AI Product Definition:** Shape requirements for agentic applications, copilots, and automations for the renewable energy sector, working with engineering to balance model performance, cost, reliability, and user experience.
* **Adoption & Enablement:** Drive adoption of launched products across the organization through onboarding, training, and user feedback loops, and track measurable productivity gains.
* **Responsible AI & Governance:** Work with engineering and legal teams to ensure products meet standards for evaluation, guardrails, data privacy, and governance.
* **Market & Innovation Insight:** Stay current with advancements in AI, agentic tooling, and the renewable energy software landscape, and translate them into actionable product opportunities for the company.

**Educational and Technical Skills**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, business, or a related field; an MBA is a plus.
* Any additional credentials that reflect an ability to operate out of the box such as having background in finance, operations, strategy will be considered a plus

**Preferred Skills**

**Product Management Proficiency:**

* Proven experience as a Product Manager owning digital or AI/ML-powered products from concept through launch and scale.
* Demonstrated ability to define product vision, build multi-quarter roadmaps, and deliver go-to-market plans.
* Strong working knowledge of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts (LLMs, RAG, agents, evaluation) sufficient to make informed trade-offs with engineering teams.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, design, legal, and sales through influence rather than direct authority.
* Proficiency in product analytics and experimentation: defining KPIs, running A/B tests, and using tools such as SQL, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Power BI.
* Experience with agile product development and tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear product requirements and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive leadership.

**Renewable Energy Systems:**

* Understanding of solar energy systems and their integration into existing infrastructure

**Experience**

* Experience launching AI copilots, chat interfaces, or workflow automation tools for internal or enterprise users.
* Experience with B2B or enterprise SaaS products, including pricing, packaging, and go-to-market.
* Track record of using user research and post-launch metrics to drive product iteration.

**Psychosocial Skills /Human Skills/Behavioural Skills**
